mapper.sql: achievement_id as "achievementId", faculty_user_id as "facultyUserId", evaluation_year as "evaluationYear", academic_year as "academicYear", semester, student_no as "studentNo", student_name as "studentName", degree_type as "degreeType", thesis_title as "thesisTitle", graduate_date as "awardDate", achievement_status as "achievementStatus", management_item_setting_id as "managementItemSettingId", dynamic_fields::text as "dynamicFieldsJson", attachment_refs::text as "attachmentRefsJson", created_at as "createdAt", updated_at as "updatedAt"

sql.where: faculty_user_id = #{facultyUserId} and deleted_yn = 'N' and evaluation_year = #{criteria.evaluationYear} and academic_year = #{criteria.academicYear} and semester = #{criteria.semester} and degree_type = #{criteria.degreeType} and achievement_status = #{criteria.achievementStatus} and (student_no ilike concat('%', #{criteria.studentKeyword}, '%') or student_name ilike concat('%', #{criteria.studentKeyword}, '%'))

mapper.select: select from graduate_achievements order by graduate_date desc, achievement_id desc limit #{criteria.safeSize} offset #{criteria.safePage} * #{criteria.safeSize}
select from graduate_achievements where achievement_id = #{achievementId} and faculty_user_id = #{facultyUserId} and deleted_yn = 'N'

select from graduate_achievements where faculty_user_id = #{facultyUserId} and student_no = #{studentNo} and degree_type = #{degreeType} and graduate_date = cast(#{awardDate} as date) and deleted_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert: insert into graduate_achievements (faculty_user_id,evaluation_year,academic_year,semester,student_no,student_name,degree_type,graduate_date,graduate_status,thesis_title,achievement_status,management_item_setting_id,dynamic_fields,attachment_refs,created_by,updated_by) values (#{facultyUserId},#{request.evaluationYear},#{request.academicYear},#{request.semester},#{request.studentNo},#{request.studentName},#{request.degreeType},#{request.awardDate},'COMPLETED',#{request.thesisTitle},'DRAFTING',#{request.managementItemSettingId},cast(#{dynamicFieldsJson} as jsonb),cast(#{attachmentRefsJson} as jsonb),#{facultyUserId},#{facultyUserId})
mapper.update: update graduate_achievements set evaluation_year=#{request.evaluationYear},academic_year=#{request.academicYear},semester=#{request.semester},student_no=#{request.studentNo},student_name=#{request.studentName},degree_type=#{request.degreeType},graduate_date=#{request.awardDate},thesis_title=#{request.thesisTitle},management_item_setting_id=#{request.managementItemSettingId},dynamic_fields=cast(#{dynamicFieldsJson} as jsonb),attachment_refs=cast(#{attachmentRefsJson} as jsonb),updated_at=current_timestamp,updated_by=#{facultyUserId} where achievement_id=#{request.achievementId} and faculty_user_id=#{facultyUserId} and deleted_yn='N' and achievement_status <> 'EVALUATION_CONFIRMED'
